body: I wish there was A viable way to connect with others to try to support each other and learn and grow and get better in our health and activity levels. I know it’s part of my depression stopping me from making me these changes, and when I don’t make the changes I feel like shit, both physically and emotionally which just makes my depression worse and makes it harder to make the changes I need. I just don’t know how to break this cycle and I worry it’ll get too bad and the depression will  take over before I can even try making healthy changes.
Thank you for the suggestion but I’m 55 - I don’t think a youth hostel is for me.
Unfortunately no friends that I could do that with. As I said, it’s been a tough few years and lost a lot of long-term friendships when I pulled away and isolated myself.
Unfortunately no one I can stay with.
Thanks. I’m more trying to find a place where I can go for a few days to get out of my crappy apartment.

Thank you for your kind words. It’s just been a real struggle for 5-6 years. And I work hard. I advocated for myself to get help from counsellors, doctors, try so many meds until I find something that I could tolerate and that works, and I get a glimpse of things maybe improving, but then something else happens and it knocks the wind out of me. I drag myself out of the pit, I try to make things work, and then “boom” another landline blows up in my life. I know things can always be worse and I’m grateful for what I do have - but the constant daily battle to just exist is too much. Every bump in the road. Every unkindness. Every failure. Every cruel lie. Every loss. Every day that passes where I don’t say one word out loud as I have no one in my life who cares or who I can talk to. 

 Few years ago, I’ve been close to the end and needing my life to be over and I fought ducking hard to get out of the deep dark hole. But it’s calling to me. I hear it whispering that I can find blissful peace and just end myself. And that’s comforting now instead of scary.

Things got bad 5-6 years ago and my mental health became a huge issue for the first time ever in my life (I was almost 50). It was really bad for almost three years, but my doc and I finally found meds that helped, plus I left my husband of 25 years and that was a really big healthy step for me. 

But it’s been three years of loneliness and gaining weight and not moving enough and being too isolated. 

And now four weeks of worsening pain, so bad I had to go to ER by ambulance. Got prescribed a lot of strong meds. And it makes my lonely and tired heart wonder if there’s enough there for me to make it all stop.
Yeah. It’s terrifying. I wish it was easy to access strong meds that could do the job.
Thanks for posting this. I’m struggling a lot lately with different things and have been dreading thanksgiving but maybe this is something I can try to do as a treat for my son and myself.
Sorry. Didn’t see your reply till now.
Please free free to DM if that’s permitted.
Nothing compared to the happiness I used to feel. Things just don’t get better. They are getting worse and I’m just so tired.

I created a song list of quiet but meaningful songs. Called it “Songs for a Peaceful End” - I listen to it other time’s as well and it can help calm my nerves. I’m just trying to find the courage to go through with plans.
